adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the loop `rss.items.each do |i|` performs several operations that can raise (`i.content.scrub` if `i.content` is nil; `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)`; `TopicEmbed.import(...)` which can raise from `URI(url)` in `absolutize_urls` or from `PostRevisor.new(post)` if `embed.post` is nil). There is no per-item rescue, so a single bad feed item aborts the whole job mid-iteration. Since `sidekiq_options retry: false` is set, that run will not be retried, and the same problematic item can cause repeated hourly failures and prevent importing later items. Additionally, `lib/topic_retriever.rb` calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` synchronously during embed retrieval, so such exceptions can also break that request path.
